verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a payments platform. The pack does not document a full account data export in open formats (CSV/JSON download or bulk archive), and it says nothing about closing an account or migrating away. API and agent tools that list transactions or invoices are developer building blocks for building an export, not the export capability itself. Exporting OpenAPI specs concerns API descriptions, not user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
